classification: serialized operation-region allocator observation and current baseline; no optimization claim
isolation: fresh process per selector/repeat; task CPU workloads serialized; shared host background uncontrolled
hypothesis: A separately initialized region maximum reveals operation live-byte peaks below historical setup highwater. Serialize callbacks and region boundaries to define an exact observer order without resetting absolute process counters.
acceptance: Focused deterministic counter, boundary, concurrency, overflow, aggregation and compatibility tests pass. Every measured region peak is at least entry/exit live bytes and at most the process highwater at exit. Exact corpus/output/refusal gates remain required.
limits: No allocator elapsed-time comparison or speedup/memory-reduction claim. Callback-order logical request sizes include background allocations and pre-existing live bytes; they exclude allocator-internal realloc overlap, physical RSS and object-owned retention. The observer mutex can perturb allocator-thread scheduling. Old v2 and v3 reports must not be mixed.
